mapper.select: SELECT MIN(device_sn) AS device_sn FROM ast_device_shipment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE AND source_system='DPPMS' GROUP BY CAST(device_sn AS BINARY) ORDER BY CAST(device_sn AS BINARY) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,tenant_id,device_sn,source_system,source_key,contract_no,package_no,shipment_time,product_code FROM (SELECT s.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CAST(device_sn AS BINARY) ORDER BY shipment_time DESC,id DESC) latest_rank FROM ast_device_shipment s WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE AND device_sn IN #{sn}AND 1=0) ranked WHERE latest_rank=1
SELECT product_code,product_model,product_name FROM ast_product_official_info WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE

SELECT `id`,`tenant_id`,`version`,`shipment_record_id`,`project_assignment_version`,`customer_assignment_version`,`sn`,`name`,`product_name`,`product_model`,`product_code`,`package_no`,`contract_no`,`status`,`source_system`,`source_key`,`source_version`,`sync_status`,`remark`,`creator`,`updater`,`shipment_time`,`synced_at`,`create_time`,`update_time`,`deleted` FROM ast_device WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND sn IN #{sn}AND 1=0FOR UPDATE
